(section) Sec. 1 (7-5-120(A))
(quote) Only a citizen of this State and of the United States who applies for registration must be registered if he meets the following qualifications
(section) Sec. 2 (7-5-675)
(quote) No voter registration card may be issued to a person who is not a United States citizen.
(other) Sec. 3: effective on approval by the Governor.
(other) version: Only one version (Introduced, 2026-02-26). Citizens-only registration wording ('Every' struck, 'Only a' added) and a bar on issuing voter registration cards to non-citizens; no ID or citizenship-proof rule in slots a-d.
(other) note: Strike/new markers restored from the HTML styling. Citizens-only language, no documentary proof or database check. Only the introduced text is saved.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
